Title: Generally Available: Azure Sphere OS version 26.06 is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Sphere OS version 26.06 is now available in the Retail feed. This release includes updates to Azure Sphere OS only; it does not include an updated SDK. If your devices are connected to the internet, they will receive the updated OS from the cloud.

This release includes quality and underlying build system updates and addresses several CVEs.

Learn more.
